ln-dawnwing.environment: The luminous heights at the edge of first light
ln-dawnwing.culture: Dawnwings are the first-light seraphim, heralds of morning who greet the dawn at the Threshold and carry its light down to the world. Hopeful where the Choir is grim, they are the most outward-facing seraphim, and many become the healers and teachers the world actually meets.
ln-dawnwing.tradition: The Ascension-Rite, a young Dawnwing's first climb to the Threshold to greet the dawn.
ln-dawnwing.appearance: Gold-white wings, dawn-lit robes, first-light halos.
ln-dawnwing.naming: Given name plus a dawn-epithet (Auriel Firstlight).
occupations: Heralds and messengers of the Choir
ln-dawnwing.landmark: The Threshold at the edge of the world
hooks: The dawn you greet has begun coming late
The Choir forbids you to carry a warning the world needs
You feel the pull to become Fallen and live among mortals

ln-starborn-s.homeland: The Star Court of the Celestial Heights
ln-starborn-s.culture: Starborn are the constellation-serving seraphim, born to a star-pattern and sworn to its watch, keepers of the oldest prophecies at the Star Court. Bound to the constellations that guide and, some say, doom them, they are the Choir's prophets and its most burdened members.
ln-starborn-s.tradition: The Constellation-Binding, when a young Starborn is bound to the star-pattern they will serve for life.
ln-starborn-s.naming: Given name plus a constellation (Vaeleth of the Crown of Nine).
ln-starborn-s.landmark: The Star Court where the constellations hold council
hooks: Your bound constellation is going dark, star by star
A prophecy names you and the Choir wants it buried
The stars over the Threshold are failing and you foresaw it

ln-radiant.homeland: The radiant orthodoxy of the Choir's high halls
ln-radiant.environment: The blazing luminous heart of the Heights
ln-radiant.culture: Radiant are the orthodox seraphim, the star-fire wielders and Threshold-guardians who form the core of the Radiant Choir. Rigid, luminous, and increasingly afraid of a prophecy they cannot silence, they hold the line against the dark and against their own doubting kin.
ln-radiant.tradition: The Kindling of the Star-Fire, when a Radiant first calls the light that they will wield in the Threshold's defense.
ln-radiant.appearance: Blazing-white wings, radiant armor, star-fire halos.
ln-radiant.naming: Given name plus a choir-rank (Seraphiel of the High Choir).
ln-radiant.landmark: The Threshold, edge of the world and beyond
hooks: A prophecy of the sky breaking again is fracturing your Choir
You are ordered to silence a Fallen you believe is right
The star-fire you wield is dimming with the stars

ln-highwing.homeland: The drifting sky-realms of the Skyward Isles
ln-highwing.environment: Floating islands and the high cloud-seas
ln-highwing.culture: Highwings are the sky-isle seraphim who dwell among the drifting islands rather than the far Heights, wardens of the Sky Covenant charged with keeping the isles aloft. More worldly than their Heights-bound kin, they work alongside birdkin and harengon and know the isles are sinking.
ln-highwing.tradition: The Isle-Warding, a rite of tending the old sky-magic that holds a drifting island up.
ln-highwing.appearance: Broad cloud-grey wings, skystone regalia, updraft-charms.
ln-highwing.naming: Given name plus an isle (Caelor of Cloudspire).
hooks: An isle you ward has begun to fall and thousands live on it
The Covenant hides what holds the isles up and you mean to learn it
A chain-bridge was cut and you saw who did it

ln-astral.homeland: The Threshold-seers of the outer Heights
ln-astral.environment: The half-real edge where the world meets the beyond
ln-astral.culture: Astral seraphim dwell at the very Threshold, seers half in the world and half out of it, who gaze into the beyond and return changed. Rarest and strangest of their kin, they speak in prophecy and are trusted and feared for how much of the other side they carry.
ln-astral.tradition: The Threshold-Gazing, a rite of looking into the beyond and returning able to say what was seen.
ln-astral.appearance: Translucent star-flecked wings, void-touched eyes, astral regalia.
ln-astral.naming: Given name plus an astral epithet (Ithuriel Farsight).
ln-astral.landmark: The Threshold, edge of the world and beyond
hooks: Your Threshold-gazing showed the sky breaking a second time
Something from the beyond followed your gaze back
The Choir needs, and fears, what you saw

ln-stoneblood.homeland: The stone-holds of the high Ironspine
ln-stoneblood.culture: Stonebloods are the mountain-hold goliaths, the core of the High Clans, who measure worth against the mountain and keep the fairest tallies of any people. Their word is stone, and a Stoneblood who claims a victory they did not earn is exiled in shame.
ln-stoneblood.tradition: The Crossing of Nine Bridges, the great coming-of-age pilgrimage above the cloud line.
ln-stoneblood.appearance: Stone-grey skin, granite-patterned marks, clan-wraps, bridge-tokens.
ln-stoneblood.naming: Given name plus a clan-and-peak (Korra of the Grey Crossing).
ln-stoneblood.landmark: The Nine Bridges above the cloud line
hooks: You failed your Crossing and wander to earn your standing
A vault-claim dispute threatens your clan-moot
The Crossing has grown deadly and something hunts the young on the bridges

ln-frostblood.homeland: The glacier-holds of the Frostbound North
ln-frostblood.culture: Frostbloods are the northern goliaths of the glacier-holds, who test themselves against the killing cold as their southern kin test themselves against the mountain. Stoic and enduring, they hold the north's high passes and keep the aurora-vigils alongside the human jarls.
ln-frostblood.tradition: The Ice-Crossing, a northern trial of crossing a glacier-field alone in deep winter.
ln-frostblood.appearance: Frost-white skin, ice-blue marks, heavy furs, glacier-tokens.
ln-frostblood.naming: Given name plus a glacier (Thura of the White Glacier).
ln-frostblood.landmark: Whitehall, carved inside a living glacier
hooks: The Winter Hunt has crossed into your clan's passes
Your Ice-Crossing found something frozen that should stay frozen
The glacier-hold's ice is failing

ln-stormblood.homeland: The tempest-height holds of the Stormreach
ln-stormblood.environment: Storm-lashed high ridges and lightning-struck peaks
ln-stormblood.culture: Stormbloods are the tempest-height goliaths who court the Storm as a test, raising holds where the lightning strikes and crossing sky-bridges in the teeth of the gale. Kin to the Stormreach's dragonborn and genasi, they hold the storm-country's highest ground.
ln-stormblood.tradition: The Storm-Crossing, a trial of crossing a sky-bridge during a living tempest.
ln-stormblood.appearance: Storm-grey skin, lightning-scar marks, storm-glass tokens.
ln-stormblood.naming: Given name plus a storm-peak (Volk of the Thunder Ridge).
hooks: A storm-crossing killed a young clanmate and the clan blames you
The Storm spoke during your crossing
Your ridge-hold's storm-bridge is failing

ln-mountainborn.homeland: The deep mining-holds of the Ironspine
ln-mountainborn.culture: Mountainborn are the miner-and-mason goliaths who work the stone rather than cross the bridges, quieter and more settled than the high clans. They quarry the great stone the forge-cities and bridge-builders need, and they hold that patient work honors the mountain as much as any trial.
ln-mountainborn.tradition: The First Quarry, a rite of cutting one's first great stone for a work meant to endure.
ln-mountainborn.appearance: Dust-grey skin, quarry-marked, mason's wraps, chisel-tokens.
ln-mountainborn.naming: Given name plus a quarry or work (Dorn of the Deep Quarry).
ln-mountainborn.landmark: The great quarries of the Ironspine
hooks: Your quarry broke into something older than the mountain
A stone you cut was for a work now cursed
Vault-raiders are tunneling through your family's mine

ln-titanborn.homeland: The oldest giant-holds near the Elemental Marches
ln-titanborn.environment: Ancient battlefields and titan-ruins of the frontier
ln-titanborn.culture: Titanborn are the rare eldest goliath bloodline, said to descend from the giants of the First Age, who guard the titan-ruins and the elemental frontier. Legend says a Titanborn held a bridge until the mountain gave way, and their line rises when the world needs an immovable thing.
ln-titanborn.tradition: The Titan-Vigil, a pilgrimage to an ancestral giant-ruin to hear the first giants' charge.
ln-titanborn.appearance: Massive even for goliaths, ancient-marked skin, first-age relic-tokens.
ln-titanborn.naming: Given name plus a titan-hold (Grommok of the Fallen Titan).
ln-titanborn.landmark: The titan-ruins of the elemental frontier
hooks: Your line rises when the world needs holding, and the rifts are widening
A titan-ruin you guard has been breached
The first giants' charge in your Titan-Vigil named a coming doom

ln-cavegoblin.environment: Lightless Deep tunnels and glowcap caverns
ln-cavegoblin.culture: Cave Goblins are the Deep-dwelling goblins of the Blackdeep, tunnel-clever survivors who farm glowcap and keep the Sunless Market running. Communal and inventive, they share every find with the warren, and they watch the Deepest Door alongside the dwarves.
ln-cavegoblin.tradition: The First Find, building something useful from pure scrap and giving it to the warren.
ln-cavegoblin.naming: Given name plus a warren (Nix of the Ninth Warren).
rivals: Whatever knocks on the Deepest Door
ln-cavegoblin.landmark: The Sunless Market, neutral ground of the Deep
hooks: Something is coming up through the Deepest Door your warren watches
The Glowfall is going dark and your farms with it
A device you built has been stolen for a war

ln-scrapborn.environment: Ruin-fields and scrap-forts of the Ashen Wastes
ln-scrapborn.culture: Scrapborn are the salvage-yard goblins of the wastes, engineers and demolitionists who make wonders from the wreckage of the burned empire. Bold and inventive, they guide expeditions into the Glass Capital and build the strangest, most useful devices in the world.
ln-scrapborn.tradition: The Scrap-Trial, a rite of building a working machine from a heap of ruin-salvage.
ln-scrapborn.naming: Given name plus a favorite build (Wexa Gearspit).
ln-scrapborn.landmark: The Glass Capital, fused to obsidian in a night
hooks: A machine you built has fallen into the wrong hands
A vault in the Glass Capital never burned and you can reach it
A rival crew stole your map to the unburned ruin

ln-nightgoblin.culture: Night Goblins are the shadow-dwelling goblins of the border, smugglers and shadow-runners who move goods and secrets through the dusk. Wary and quick, they run the Grey Market's underside and know the safe ways through the failing light.
ln-nightgoblin.tradition: The Gloom-Run, a rite of moving a cargo through the shadow-border and back unseen.
ln-nightgoblin.appearance: Dusk-dark skin, night-eyes, muffled dark gear, smuggler's charms.
ln-nightgoblin.naming: Given name plus a run (Skritch of the Grey Run).
ln-nightgoblin.landmark: The Grey Market where living and returned trade
hooks: A cargo you ran turned out to be Unlit contraband
The shadow-border is closing your safe routes
You smuggled a person who is worth more than you were told

ln-redcap.homeland: The old blood-rite warrens of the border
ln-redcap.culture: Redcaps are the goblins of the old blood-rites, feared and misunderstood even among their own kind for the reputation the Blood Wars left them. In truth most Redcaps are grim border-guards bound by old, harsh traditions they did not choose, and the tale that they are all murderers is one goblins hate to tell.
ln-redcap.tradition: The Reddening, a fraught coming-of-age blood-rite most Redcaps spend their lives reckoning with.
ln-redcap.appearance: Blood-marked caps, grim, battle-scarred, old-rite tokens.
ln-redcap.naming: Given name plus a grim epithet (Grukt Redcap).
occupations: Mercenaries no one else will hire
rivals: Those who fear the Redcap name
ln-redcap.landmark: The old battle-grounds of the border
hooks: You left the warren rather than complete the Reddening
Someone commits crimes and blames your Redcap name
The old blood-rite binds you to a debt you would break

ln-mossborn.homeland: The quiet forest-warrens of the Emerald Wilds
ln-mossborn.culture: Mossborn are the gentle forest goblins of the Wilds, herbalists and root-warren keepers who live quietly among the trees and keep peace with the Greenwardens. Contrary to every goblin stereotype, they are healers and gardeners, and their moss-lore mends what the forest wounds.
ln-mossborn.tradition: The Root-Tending, a rite of nursing a stretch of forest back to health to earn a warren's trust.
ln-mossborn.appearance: Moss-green skin, leaf-and-bark gear, herb-pouches, root-charms.
ln-mossborn.naming: Given name plus a hollow (Fennit of the Green Hollow).
ln-mossborn.landmark: The mossy hollows of the deep Wilds
hooks: A blight is spreading through the forest you tend
Your moss-lore is the only cure for a spreading sickness
The Wilds have called in a debt your warren owes

ln-boomborn.homeland: The blast-mining outposts of the Ironspine and wastes
ln-boomborn.culture: Boomborn are the demolitionist goblins, reckless geniuses of blast-mining and alchemy who clear the tunnels and bring down the walls no one else can. Loud, singed, and grinning, they are prized and feared for their love of a controlled, or barely-controlled, explosion.
ln-boomborn.tradition: The First Blast, a rite of setting a single perfect charge to prove one can be trusted with a bigger one.
ln-boomborn.appearance: Singed, wild-eyed, blast-goggled, charge-belts and fuse-charms.
ln-boomborn.naming: Given name plus a blast (Kabang of the Deep Cut).
hooks: Your last blast opened something that should have stayed sealed
A rival crew wants your secret charge-formula
You are the only one who can safely bring down a failing structure

ln-flameborn.environment: Rivers of fire and the fire-realm's leaking edge
ln-flameborn.culture: Flameborn are the fire-realm genasi of the Marches, pact-tenders who keep the flame in balance and work the living-fire forges. Passionate and disciplined at once, they tend fire-shrines and hold that their flame is a relationship to keep, not a weapon to spend.
ln-flameborn.tradition: The First Kindling, when a young Flameborn's inner fire fully wakes, tended at a fire-shrine.
ln-flameborn.naming: Given name plus a flame (Cinder of the Bright Forge).
rivals: Those who would douse the pacts
hooks: Your inner fire kindled beyond your control
A fire-pact you tend is failing and the flame is spreading
An elemental-pact offered you power for a burning price

ln-tideborn-g.homeland: The water-halls of the Marches springs
ln-tideborn-g.environment: Pools of living water where the water-realm leaks through
ln-tideborn-g.culture: Tideborn genasi are the water-realm folk of the Marches, keepers of the living springs whose bodies flow like the water in their blood. Calm and adaptable, they tend water-shrines and mediate the frontier's disputes, for water shapes itself to any vessel.
ln-tideborn-g.tradition: The Spring-Tending, the lifelong care of a living-water spring tied to one's pact.
ln-tideborn-g.appearance: Water-blue skin, flowing forms, spring-marked, water-woven wraps.
ln-tideborn-g.naming: Given name plus a spring (Nerin of the Clear Spring).
rivals: Those who would drain the springs
ln-tideborn-g.landmark: The living-water springs of the Marches
hooks: Your spring is running strange and the pact fears the rift
A rift is flooding the frontier and your pact must hold it
You are asked to mediate a feud that wants no peace

ln-stoneborn-g.environment: Floating stone and the earth-realm's leaking edge
ln-stoneborn-g.culture: Stoneborn genasi are the earth-realm folk of the Marches, patient and immovable pact-tenders whose skin is living stone and whose holds float on earth-magic. Steadfast as the goliaths they befriend, they tend stone-shrines and hold the frontier's most stubborn ground.
ln-stoneborn-g.tradition: The Setting, a rite of anchoring a floating stone to found a hold meant to endure.
ln-stoneborn-g.naming: Given name plus a hold (Tern of the Floating Gate).
hooks: The stone your hold floats on is failing
A rift has opened beneath your ground
An elemental-pact wants your hold's anchor-stone

ln-windborn.homeland: The high wind-holds where the air-realm leaks through
ln-windborn.environment: Standing winds and the air-realm's leaking edge
ln-windborn.culture: Windborn are the air-realm genasi of the Marches, free-spirited pact-tenders who ride the standing winds and tend the sky-shrines. Restless and quick, they are the scouts and messengers of the frontier, and their pact is with the wind that will not be held.
ln-windborn.tradition: The First Gust, when a young Windborn's wind-nature wakes and lifts them for the first time.
ln-windborn.appearance: Sky-pale skin, wind-tossed forms, air-marked, light flowing wraps.
ln-windborn.naming: Given name plus a wind (Zeph of the High Gust).
rivals: Those who would cage the wind
ln-windborn.landmark: The standing winds of the Marches
hooks: The wind you tend has begun to still, an ill omen
A rift is loosing wild winds across the frontier
You carry a message on the wind that must not be caught

ln-stormborn-g.homeland: The storm-shrines of the Stormreach frontier
ln-stormborn-g.environment: Standing storms where the storm-realm meets the world
ln-stormborn-g.culture: Stormborn genasi are the storm-realm folk born where the tempest and the elemental storm-realm meet, kin to the living Storm itself. Traced to the Stormfall, they tend storm-shrines and crackle with barely-held lightning, and the Stormwardens watch them as closely as they watch the Storm.
ln-stormborn-g.tradition: The First Bolt, when a young Stormborn's storm-nature wakes in a strike of held lightning.
ln-stormborn-g.appearance: Storm-violet skin, static-lit hair, lightning-marked, storm-glass wraps.
ln-stormborn-g.naming: Given name plus a storm (Raiden of the Standing Rift).
ln-stormborn-g.landmark: The Standing Rift, a permanent tear into the storm-realm
hooks: The Standing Rift is widening and your pact must hold it
Your held lightning is slipping loose
The Storm claims you as its own and the Wardens want you tested

ln-frostborn-g.homeland: The frost-shrines of the cold Marches
ln-frostborn-g.environment: The elemental cold where the frost-realm leaks through
ln-frostborn-g.culture: Frostborn genasi are the frost-realm folk of the cold frontier, still and patient pact-tenders whose breath rimes the air and whose calm hides a killing chill. Traced to the drowning cold of the Stormfall, they tend frost-shrines and guard the frozen border of the Marches.
ln-frostborn-g.tradition: The Stillness, a rite of holding one's inner frost in perfect check through a long cold night.
ln-frostborn-g.appearance: Frost-cyan skin, ice-crystal hair, rime-marked, frost-woven wraps.
ln-frostborn-g.naming: Given name plus a frost (Vael of the Silent Frost).
rivals: Those who would thaw the sealed cold
ln-frostborn-g.landmark: The frozen shrines of the Marches
hooks: Your inner frost will not still and the cold is spreading
A frost-rift is freezing the frontier
Something the cold preserved is thawing near your shrine
